items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: I made a recording with Rainey. Mm-hmm. Kid Rainey.

ctx.x: So he played violin here in the city too. Oh yeah. Let's see. You made the Sam Morgan recording. Then what was the next recording after that?
I made a recording with Rainey. Mm-hmm. Kid Rainey. That's the next recording. What recording else I made after that?
You know Harrison Barnes told me, I mean Harrison Brasley, told me he's supposed to make those records but he couldn't do it.
